methods.label: Take square roots directly
methods.explanation: The left-hand side is a perfect square. Taking square roots directly gives \(x+1=\pm4\), so \(x=3\) or \(x=-5\).
methods.levelReason: Direct square-root solving is a Grade 9 method supported by the meaning of square roots and simple linear equations.
